propositions: A pure detector function returns a warning string when an acting session differs from the claimed_session holder, with conditions: enabled flag true, acting_session non-null, claimed_session present, and ids unequal.
The detector returns None (silent) when enabled=False, acting_session=None, claimed_session absent, or when the acting session equals the claimed session.

The warnings.cross_session config toggle (boolean, default True) is wired through the Config schema at four coordinated sites: WarningsConfig dataclass, Config.warnings field, _SECTION_CLASSES registry, and _SECTIONS coercer registry.

The convenience function cross_session_warning_for reads the config toggle and session id before loading state, short-circuiting to avoid unnecessary I/O when the warning is disabled or acting session is unknown.
The warning message includes the claim_harness tag when present, otherwise only the claimed_session id.
The detector is intentionally silent when acting_session is None to avoid false positives in un-shimmed environments where session id is unknown.
